# Descriptions
@@ 1
Target is healed of d10 concussion hits.
@@ 2
Target is healed of one area of up to mild frostbite or 1st degree burn.
@@ 3
Target is healed of one minor irritation (e.g., headache, toothache,
bee-sting, hangover, etc.).
@@ 4
As Healing I, except that target is healed of 3d10 concussion hits.
@@ 5
Target is relieved of 1 round’s worth of accumulated stun effects.
@@ 6
As Frost/Burn Relief I, except caster can heal 2 areas of mild damage or 1
area of moderate damage (e.g., 2nd degree burn).
@@ 7
Will reduce damage target has by 1 hit every minute as long as caster
concentrates. If the caster is unconscious this spell will operate on him
without concentration.
@@ 8
As Healing I except that target is healed of 5d10 concussion hits.
@@ 9
As Frost/Burn Relief I, except caster can heal 3 areas of mild damage or 1
area of severe damage (e.g., 3rd degree burn) or a combination of 1 mild and 1
moderate area of damage.
@@ 10
Target is instantly awake.
@@ 11
As Healing I, except that target is healed of 7d10 concussion hits.
@@ 12
As Regeneration I, except target’s damage is reduced by 2 hits per minute of
concentration.
@@ 13
As Frost/Burn Relief I, except caster can heal 4 mild or 2 moderate or 1 mild
and 1 severe or 2 mild and 1 moderate area(s) of damage.
@@ 15
As Healing I, except that target is healed of 10d10 concussion hits.
@@ 17
As Stun Relief, except that the caster’s range is 100'.
@@ 18
As Regeneration I, except target’s damage is reduced by 3 hits per minute.
@@ 20
As Healing I, except that target is healed of 15d10 concussion hits.
@@ 25
As Regeneration I, except target’s damage is reduced by 5 hits per minute.
@@ 30
As Healing I, except that target is healed of all concussion hits.
@@ 50
Allows caster to heal all concussion hits in a number of targets equal to
level of caster.
